title: BGVD-State: Replayable Middleware for Evidence-Gated Handoffs in Third-Party Software Security Review
description: Model-independent discovery-state runtime for recording defensive security-agent events, replaying candidate and failed-path lifecycle, binding material and verifier evidence, rejecting stale evidence, persisting state, enforcing verifier-gated finalization, and building auditable handoff packets. The repository contains a de-identified engineering case, deterministic and performance validation, sanitized replay fixtures, and an offline artifact validator. It contains no live targets, credentials, operational exploit commands, network addresses, or target-specific reproduction procedures.
